outline.chapter_title: Chapter 1: Procedural Posture and Factual Background
outline.description: This chapter establishes the foundational context of the case, detailing the specific criminal events that formed the basis of the prosecution, the statutory charges brought by the government, and the scope of the appellate review. It explains the transition from the trial court's discretion to the appellate court's jurisdiction, setting the stage for the legal analysis regarding evidence and sentencing.
subtopics: Factual Basis of the Firearms Possession (Incident chronology and victim testimony)
Statutory Charges: 18 U.S.C. \u00a7\u00a9 922(g)(1), 924(e), and the Armed Career Criminal Act
Procedural History: Conviction, Sentencing Recommendation, and District Court Rulings
Scope of Appeal: Chorom Evidentiary Errors and Sentencing Enhancements (Section 2K2.1(b)(6)(B))

outline.chapter_title: Chapter 2: Evidentiary Rulings, Admissibility, and Harmless Error
outline.description: This chapter focuses on the trial court's evidentiary rulings that the defendant challenged on appeal. It breaks down the application of Federal Rules of Evidence 403 and 404(b), the interpretation of the Confrontation Clause regarding hearsay and prior witness statements, and the standard of review used by the appellate court.
subtopics: Rule 404(b) Analysis: Prior Possession as Intrinsic Evidence vs. Propensity Evidence
Confrontation Clause and Hearsay: Instructing the Jury on Victim Testimony Against Officers
Impeachment and Authentication: Admissibility of Prior Consistent/Inconsistent Statements regarding the Gun
Harmless Error Standard: Reviewing whether Evidence Swayed the Verdict or Had Cumulative Effect

outline.chapter_title: Chapter 3: Sentencing Guidelines: Calculation and Specific Enhancements
outline.description: This chapter explains the mathematical application of the Sentencing Guidelines at the appellate level. It details how the University of the Complaint Investigator's (PSR) calculation was reviewed, specifically focusing on the enhancement for connection to another felony offense and the calculation of the base offense level.
subtopics: Determining the Base Offense Level: Sawed-off Firearm and Chartering Risk of Death
USSG \u00a7 2K2.1(b)(6)(B): Application of the 'Connection to Another Felony' Enhancement
ACCA Eligibility: Finding Three Prior Violent Felony Convictions
Conflict Resolution: When the Guidelines Exceed Other Possible Calculations

outline.chapter_title: Chapter 4: Substantive Reasonableness and Sentencing Discretion
outline.description: This chapter addresses the final phase of the sentencing analysis, focusing on the district court's discretion in imposing a specific term of imprisonment within the calculated Guidelines range. It covers the Supreme Court's standard for reviewing reasonableness under the substantive and procedural requirements of the Sentencing Act.
subtopics: The Four-Step Review Process: Calculated Range to Reasonableness
Presumption of Reasonableness for Within-Guidelines Sentencing
Analysis of 18 U.S.C. \u00a7 3553(a) Factors (Purposes of Sentencing)
The District Court's Consideration Record and Abuse of Discretion Review
Final Disposition: Affirming the Sentence and Procedural Boundaries
